# Perla Diş Kliniği

> Perla Diş Kliniği is a comprehensive dental clinic in Antalya offering specialized treatments in implantology, orthodontics, prosthodontics, and cosmetic dentistry with experienced oral surgeons and modern CAD/CAM technology.

Located in Muratpaşa, Antalya, Perla Dental Clinic provides a full range of dental services from routine care to advanced surgical procedures. The clinic is led by Dr. Onur Ademhan and features a team of specialist doctors including orthodontists and prosthodontics experts.

## Key Topics

- Dental implants
- Orthodontics
- Root canal treatment
- Teeth whitening
- Prosthodontics
- CAD/CAM technology
- Invisalign
- Oral surgery
- Cosmetic dentistry
- Dr. Onur Ademhan
- Dr. Eldar Aydınlı
- Dr. İbrahim Alkan
- Antalya
- Appointment booking
- Patient care

## Core Services & Treatments

- [Dental Treatments Overview](https://www.perladis.com/tedaviler): Overview of dental treatments including implants, orthodontics, and whitening
- [Dental Implant Treatment](https://www.perladis.com/tedaviler/dis-implant-tedavisi): Dental implant treatment with titanium implants for tooth replacement
- [Orthodontic Treatment](https://www.perladis.com/tedaviler/dis-teli-tedavisi): Orthodontic treatment with braces and Invisalign in Antalya
- [Root Canal Treatment](https://www.perladis.com/tedaviler/kanal-tedavisi): Root canal treatment for infected or damaged teeth in Antalya
- [Teeth Whitening](https://www.perladis.com/tedaviler/dis-beyazlatma): Laser teeth whitening with Zoom technology for cosmetic dentistry
- [Prosthetic Dentures & Restoration](https://www.perladis.com/tedaviler/protez-dis-tedavisi): Prosthetic dentures and dental restoration with CAD/CAM technology
